record.name: Facility phases and geographical evidence
record.role: Keeps physical sites, organizational names and development stages distinct before counting capacity.
record.description: A cloud region, campus, building, availability zone and project phase are different entities. One campus can operate an early phase while constructing another and announcing a third. Different organizations may describe the same physical capacity as owner, operator, cloud provider or customer, creating double-counting risk. The Stargate and India hub announcements illustrate why dated status belongs to a specific phase and amount. Source date, checked date and power boundary distinguish the reported snapshot from later events; announced megawatts do not automatically count as operating capacity. Counts of factories or access centers require their own definitions and cannot be treated as equal-sized facilities.

record.scale: Facility phases to region and world; geography schematic
mechanism: Resolve the physical site and identify any separately dated construction or operating phases.
Identify each organization’s role without counting the same hardware again under another name.
Attach capacity only to the phase and status directly supported by the source.

Aggregate only compatible non-overlapping records and display the census’s coverage limits.
record.misconception: A planned gigawatt campus is not a gigawatt of operating compute, and an access antenna is not an equivalent data-center building.

check.question: How should a partly operating campus with an announced expansion be recorded?
options: As two unrelated copies of the same total
As separate phases with their own status and capacity
As fully operating at its final planned size
check.explanation: Phase records preserve real progress while preventing planned and operating quantities from being merged.

science.title: Status-scoped aggregation
science.explanation: Cp is compatible capacity for non-overlapping phase p at time t; the indicator selects one status.
science.assumptions: Only sum identical units and power boundaries; unknown amounts remain excluded or explicitly unresolved.

record.learningObjective: Build a capacity record that preserves geography, identity, phase and evidence status.
record.engineeringExample: Synthetic campus has 20 MW operating and a separate 80 MW planned expansion. Its operating total remains 20 MW; 100 MW describes combined eventual scope only if both figures use the same boundary.

variables.meaning: Compatible capacity with selected status s at time t
Capacity of nonoverlapping phase p at time t
Source-reported categorical status of phase p
Indicator: one when the stated status matches, zero otherwise

formalEquations.text: Status-scoped capacity sums each nonoverlapping phase’s compatible capacity only when its status matches the selected category.
formalEquations.note: The subscript s replaces the repeated word status to distinguish a selected category from the phase’s status function. Unknown capacity is not silently treated as zero.
